notes.title: The "Masquerade" Update Is Here!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40933494/0f1662ab8e38f0c2c37f9c5b120dcff1e9d37743.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]The "Masquerade" Update Is Here![/b][/h1][h3]This is more than just a battle. Each arena is now a stage, with its own rules, secrets, and unpredictable roles. Not all enemies fight fair—some have a way of vanishing and reappearing where you least expect. Beware the shadows. Victory isn't always earned through firepower. Sometimes, the mind must lead where weapons cannot.[/h3][p][/p][h2][i]One level feels... different. As if someone — or something — is watching. But to understand, you’ll have to play your part to the end. Just be careful not to wake what sleeps. Or has it already awakened?...[/i][/h2][p][/p][h3]New, level-specific perks have been introduced, making every stage a unique gameplay experience. Some levels hide bosses. Others offer surprises of a different kind. What awaits you? That’s for you to discover.[/h3][p][/p][h3]All maps have been reworked from the ground up — with new visuals, redesigned arenas, stunning reflections, and dynamic lighting.
"Masquerade" changes everything.
Are you ready to take the stage?[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704170/Tank_Battle_Royale/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40933494/98c373e5bd3a14542efe184d8c75c894b0e28a45.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]New DLCs have arrived, featuring powerful new tanks and exclusive level decoration packs! [/b][/h1][h3]Stand out like never before — only you will see the decorations you've unlocked, but everyone will see the tanks you bring to the battlefield.[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826740/Tank_Battle_Royale__Beautiful_Things/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
